source.snippet: I wish there was a tool that allowed me to send my clipboard to a server and anytime I sent something to the clipboard it checks the ssh hosts file for the config and sends it off. I'd like to 'paste' on any other machine with an ssh command.

problem_statement: Developers and sysadmins who work across multiple machines via SSH have no seamless way to sync clipboard contents between hosts; copying on one machine and pasting on another requires manual workarounds.
target_segment: Software developers and sysadmins who regularly SSH into multiple remote machines and need cross-host clipboard sync.
notes: Single HN comment expressing desire for the tool; no explicit price signal but dev-tool context suggests willingness to pay for a polished solution. Older signal (2022) but the workflow gap persists.
